title: Bearded Man with Mosaic Egg
description: A smiling man with a long reddish beard and short hair stands in the center of a vibrant, surreal floral scene. He is surrounded by oversized daisies and flowers in pink, purple, yellow and white, with a large colorful mosaic Easter egg in the foreground and faint stone archways visible in the background.
prompt: A smiling man with a long thick reddish-brown beard and short hair stands among giant vibrant flowers including pink, purple, yellow and white daisies with red centers. A large ornate mosaic Easter egg with colorful tiles sits in the foreground. Soft stone archways and water are faintly visible in the dreamy background. Bright, whimsical, painterly style with visible brushstrokes and blended colors.
